title: Financial Services
description: Harborview Community Bank, a fictional regional bank with 18 branches: a sample of its retail customers, accounts, monthly balances, loans, loan payments and card disputes from April 2025 to September 2026, a credit risk report workbook, and its credit policy, KYC and AML procedure, complaint procedure, fee schedule, a Q3 2026 risk committee deck and a scanned loan modification request.
disclaimer: Synthetic data for a software demonstration: Harborview Community Bank, its customers, loans and documents are fictional and describe no real institution or person. Not financial, credit or legal advice.

questions.label: Mortgage limits at a 700 score
questions.description: Reads the underwriting table in the consumer credit policy PDF.
questions.question: Under the consumer credit policy, what is the maximum debt-to-income ratio and the maximum loan-to-value for a mortgage applicant with a 700 credit score?

questions.label: Scanned loan modification request
questions.description: Needs Nemotron Parse to read a scanned, signed form.
questions.question: In the scanned loan modification request, which loan is the borrower asking to modify, and what payment relief are they requesting?

questions.label: Complaint handling deadlines
questions.description: Reads the service-level table in the complaint handling procedure (DOCX).
questions.question: A customer complains that their loan modification request was denied. How soon must the bank acknowledge and resolve the complaint, and when does it escalate to the Complaint Resolution Team?

questions.label: Top branches by deposits
questions.description: Joins accounts to monthly balances for September 2026.
questions.question: Which five branches held the most deposits (checking and savings balances) at the end of September 2026, and how much did each hold?

questions.label: Delinquency by loan product
questions.description: Reads the delinquency sheet of the credit risk report workbook.
questions.question: Which loan product had the highest 30-day delinquency rate in September 2026, and how does each product compare with September 2025?

questions.label: Card disputes in Q3 2026
questions.description: Counts and sums card disputes filed in the third quarter.
questions.question: How many card disputes were filed in the third quarter of 2026, how much money was disputed in total, and which reason was the most common?

questions.label: Loans above the policy DTI limit
questions.description: Reads the DTI limits from the policy and applies them to this year's personal loans.
questions.question: Which personal loans originated this year would no longer meet the credit policy's maximum DTI for their credit band at origination?

questions.label: Risk deck against the loan data
questions.description: Checks the delinquency figures in the Q3 deck against the loan payment tables.
questions.question: The Q3 2026 risk committee deck reports a 30-day delinquency rate for each loan product. Do those figures match what the loan and payment tables show at 30 September 2026?
